name: Hangzhou First Applied Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou First Applied Material Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sales of new materials in China and internationally. It operates through Photovoltaic Materials, Electronic Materials, Functional Film Materials, and Coating Materials divisions. The company offers photovoltaic encapsulant film, such as EVA film for PV module, POE encapsulant, co-extrusion film, color encapsulant, light conversion film, and special film for busbar-free (0BB) PV module; backsheet for PV module; and isolation strips, reflective gap encapsulant, moisture barrier sealant, structural adhesive, insulating ink, isolating ink, and wet-film photoresist. …
